title: Induced EMF
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the motional EMF using the formula E = B L v, yielding 6 V.

title: Induced Current
description: Essential: Correctly applies Ohm's law (I = E / R) to find the current of 2 A for part (2).

title: Magnetic Force Balance
description: Important: Recognizes that for constant velocity, the pulling force F equals the magnetic force BIL.

title: Work Calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the work done by the pulling force using W = F v Δt, yielding 1.2 J for part (3).

title: Circuit with Internal Resistance
description: Important: For part (4), correctly finds the total current using I' = E / (R + r).

title: Rod Terminal Voltage
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the voltage across the rod using U = I' r, yielding 4.5 V for part (4).

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units (V, A, J, Ω, T, m, s) throughout the solution.

title: Sign or Direction Error
description: Pitfall: Misapplies Lenz's law or assigns incorrect sign to induced current/EMF direction.

title: Ohm's Law Misapplication
description: Pitfall: For part (4), incorrectly uses U = E or U = I' R instead of U = I' r for the rod's voltage.
